prompt:
Create exactly ONE production sprite sheet image using your native image_gen tool (the same built-in image-generation route used for the attached Fraus-chan assets, requested as gpt-image-2). This is an image-generation-only task: do not write application code, do not inspect any repository, do not use an API fallback or another image model. Call the built-in image_gen tool directly; it does not require a CLI model-selection argument or OPENAI_API_KEY. The two attached images show the SAME character Fraus-chan; the existing full-body pose is the primary identity and rendering reference, the character sheet is the secondary facial reference.

OUTPUT: a 2048x2048 PNG sprite sheet, transparent background, four equal 1024x1024 cells in an EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows grid. No drawn grid, no labels, no scenery, no text, no borders. Each cell has exactly one complete character, full body including feet, rendered at identical scale (about 900px tall inside each 1024px cell), same camera height and front three-quarter perspective, feet around the same baseline, generous transparent margins. No limb, hair, thread or accessory may cross the cell boundary. These are four consecutive key poses of a single short entrance animation, NOT four different characters. Keep character face, eye positions, costume and silhouette highly consistent across all four poses. Do not draw a door, portal, curtain, frame or wall: the website will draw the diagonal seam she interacts with.

CHARACTER IDENTITY: young adult anime woman, same proportions and face as the primary reference, long dark graphite hair with warm gold undersides and ONE pale-gold front streak; asymmetric fringe; thin gold survey-ring hairpin with fine ticks and a small needle on her left side of head (viewer's right); amber eye on viewer's LEFT, pale blue eye on viewer's RIGHT; warm peach skin; cream high-collar puff-sleeve blouse; graphite sleeveless pinafore dress, distinctive diagonal skirt opening with gold edging; gold thread belt; dark charcoal leggings; cream heeled ankle boots; tiny round gold FR collar pin; delicate gold thread and brass plumb-bob accessory. No new clothing, wings, hats, cape, weapons, animal ears or extra ornaments. Match the existing reference art's polished anime/vector-like rendering, broad clean color shapes, restrained shading, soft blush, crisp clean silhouettes. Do not turn her into pixel art, 3D, photorealism or a different chibi style. Palette graphite, warm cream and muted gold, amber and pale blue eyes.

CELL TOP LEFT — PEEK: she is playfully peeking around an invisible vertical seam just to her right (viewer's right), both hands lightly gripping that invisible edge at shoulder/chest height, head and upper body leaning left into the scene. Curious open eyes, tiny mischievous smile. Her entire body remains drawn, one knee slightly bent behind the other. This must be a genuinely NEW leaning/peeking pose, not the existing neutral portrait.

CELL TOP RIGHT — PULL: continuation of the peek. She braces her feet, leans left and pulls the invisible seam open with both hands together near her right shoulder (viewer's right). There is clear gentle effort in her shoulders and elbows, weight on the left foot, determined cute expression. Hair and skirt trail to the right. Keep the figure complete, no physical door or fabric prop.

CELL BOTTOM LEFT — STEP THROUGH: she has released the seam and steps toward the center/front, one boot forward, body in a lively three-quarter stance, one hand extended for balance, the other holding her thin gold plumb line. Hair and skirt follow the step with a clean small sweep. A pleased almost-surprised smile; same face, scale and outfit.

CELL BOTTOM RIGHT — GREET: she has settled facing the viewer, feet planted naturally, one hand raised with open palm in a friendly small wave, the other relaxed holding the brass plumb bob beside her hip. Warm confident smile, bright eyes, hair settling. A genuinely NEW waving pose, not a copy of the old pose. Full body with the same scale and baseline as the other three cells.

Use a genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no ground shadow or glow. Generate this one image once with the built-in image_gen tool, then copy the generated PNG unchanged to the current working directory as entrada-sheet.png. Return only the saved image path. Do not replace native generation with a CLI/API call, and do not substitute an existing image.
